description: Use this when the signed-in owner asks how their posts did: reach, likes, comments, saves and shares for each post Suara published for them in the last days (7 by default, up to 30), plus follower change on Instagram when available. Only the platforms' real numbers: a number not shared yet is left out, and posts under a day old are still counting. Read only.
name: post_stats
title: How my posts did
